capacity\_model.json: everything the planner needs from one run, so servtuner plan never reads raw data. Per-stage curves are per replica: the run's achieved RPS over its ready replicas.

Schema file: `schema/json/bundle/capacity-model.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `e6069c17f6fe`.

## Top level

| Field              | Type                                                                  | Required | Description                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `analyzer_version` | `string`                                                              | Yes      |                                                                                                                                            |
| `run_id`           | `string`                                                              | Yes      |                                                                                                                                            |
| `identity`         | [modelIdentity](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#modelidentity)     | Yes      |                                                                                                                                            |
| `ready_replicas`   | `integer`                                                             | Yes      | Replicas of the workload under test during the usable stages; 0 when unknown, and then the curves cannot be scaled. ≥ 0                    |
| `stages`           | array of [modelStage](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#modelstage)  | Yes      |                                                                                                                                            |
| `per_replica`      | [modelPerReplica](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#modelperreplica) | No       |                                                                                                                                            |
| `queueing`         | [modelQueueing](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#modelqueueing)     | No       |                                                                                                                                            |
| `memory`           | [modelMemory](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#modelmemory)         | No       |                                                                                                                                            |
| `scale_out`        | `object`                                                              | Yes      | Replica counts the model was measured at. Linear scale-out is verified only by runs at two or more counts with per-replica RPS within 10%. |
| `infra_cost`       | [infraCost](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#infracost)             | No       |                                                                                                                                            |
| `token_cost`       | [tokenCost](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#tokencost)             | No       |                                                                                                                                            |

## Definitions

### tokenCost

Token cost of the requests at the SLO-max stage, from the bundled datasheet and the router's own cost counter. Absent when token\_pricing is none. An unpriced model is is\_priced false with a reason, never free.

| Field                             | Type                                                         | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `is_priced`                       | `boolean`                                                    | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `reason`                          | `string`                                                     | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `model`                           | `string`                                                     | Yes      | The model the requests named (target.model).                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `datasheet_key`                   | `string`                                                     | No       | The datasheet entry that priced it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `datasheet_fetched_at`            | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp)      | No       | When servtuner run fetched the datasheet that priced it (pricing/token.json): the prices are as of then.                                                                                                                                           |
| `datasheet_source`                | `"runspec"`, `"price_book"`, `"bifrost_config"`, `"default"` | No       | Where that datasheet came from: pricing/token.json's url\_basis (price\_book is the operator's).                                                                                                                                                   |
| `stage_index`                     | `integer`                                                    | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `method`                          | `"router_metric"`, `"datasheet"`, `"manual"`                 | No       | router\_metric: the router's own cost counter (Bifrost bifrost\_cost\_total, LiteLLM litellm\_spend\_metric\_total), authoritative; datasheet: servtuner's own tokens × base prices; manual: servtuner's own tokens × the RunSpec's manual prices. |
| `usd_per_1k_requests`             | `number`                                                     | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `usd_per_1m_output_tokens`        | `number`                                                     | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `datasheet_usd_per_1k_requests`   | `number`                                                     | No       | servtuner's calculation, kept as the cross-check when the router's metric is used. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                             |
| `divergence`                      | `number`                                                     | No       | \|router − datasheet\| ÷ router, when both exist; over 0.05 is reported. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `retry_added_usd_per_1k_requests` | `number`                                                     | No       | Router cost minus the cost of the client's successful requests: what retries and fallbacks added (rules B4 and L3).                                                                                                                                |
| `approximations`                  | array of `string`                                            | No       | What the calculation does not model.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

### infraCost

Infrastructure cost of one replica at the recommended sizing, from pricing/infra.json. Absent when the run's infra\_pricing source is none; is\_priced false, with a reason, when the source has no price for this hardware.

| Field                      | Type                    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`                   | `"static"`, `"aws"`     | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `is_priced`                | `boolean`               | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `reason`                   | `string`                | No       | Why there is no price.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `usd_per_replica_hour`     | `number`                | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `method`                   | `"gpu"`, `"node_share"` | No       | gpu: the replica pays for the GPUs it holds (node price ÷ node GPUs, or the GPU model's price). node\_share: it pays for the larger of its share of the node's allocatable cores and memory. |
| `basis`                    | `string`                | No       | The calculation with its values, for display.                                                                                                                                                |
| `discount`                 | `number`                | No       | &gt; 0; ≤ 1                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `usd_per_1k_requests`      | `number`                | No       | A replica's hour over the requests it serves in an hour at its SLO-max RPS, per thousand (the infra\_cost\_per\_1k\_requests objective). ≥ 0                                                 |
| `usd_per_1m_output_tokens` | `number`                | No       | The same per million output tokens, from the SLO-max stage's output token rate per replica. ≥ 0                                                                                              |
| `unit_cost_reason`         | `string`                | No       | Why a priced replica has no cost per request or per output token (no SLO-max, no replica count, no output token rate).                                                                       |

### modelIdentity

What the model is valid for: a plan inherits this scope (Guard rails 3).

| Field                 | Type                                                      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `target_type`         | [targetType](/reference/runspec/#targettype)              | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `knobs`               | map of [knobValue](/reference/runspec/#knobvalue)         | Yes      | Knob values captured from the target.                                                                                                                        |
| `hardware_profile_id` | `string`                                                  | No       |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `workload_hash`       | `string`                                                  | Yes      | SHA-256 of the RunSpec's workload block as canonical JSON, without its seed: runs with the same hash measured the same request mix. pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `workload_preset`     | [presetRef](/reference/runspec/#presetref)                | No       | The workload preset the run named, when it named one.                                                                                                        |
| `arrival_process`     | [pacing](/reference/runspec/#pacing)                      | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `quality_grade`       | [qualityGrade](/reference/schemas/analysis/#qualitygrade) | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                              |

### latencyPoint

A latency percentile of one stage, seconds; absent when the stage had too few samples for it.

| Field | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `p50` | `number` | No       | ≥ 0         |
| `p95` | `number` | No       | ≥ 0         |
| `p99` | `number` | No       | ≥ 0         |

### modelStage

| Field             | Type                                                            | Required | Description                                                             |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stage_index`     | `integer`                                                       | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                     |
| `rps_per_replica` | `number`                                                        | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                     |
| `is_usable`       | `boolean`                                                       | Yes      | Valid and not excluded: only usable stages may be interpolated between. |
| `error_rate`      | `number`                                                        | Yes      | ≥ 0; ≤ 1                                                                |
| `ttft_seconds`    | [latencyPoint](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#latencypoint) | No       |                                                                         |
| `e2e_seconds`     | [latencyPoint](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#latencypoint) | No       |                                                                         |
| `itl_seconds`     | [latencyPoint](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#latencypoint) | No       |                                                                         |

### modelPerReplica

The recommended resources of one replica at the operating point (recommendations.json), summed over the workload's containers.

| Field                         | Type      | Required | Description |
| ----------------------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `cpu_request_cores`           | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0         |
| `memory_request_bytes`        | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0         |
| `cpu_limit_cores`             | `number`  | No       | ≥ 0         |
| `memory_limit_bytes`          | `number`  | No       | ≥ 0         |
| `gpus`                        | `integer` | No       | ≥ 0         |
| `hpa_cpu_utilization_percent` | `number`  | No       | ≥ 0         |

### modelQueueing

The operating stage's queueing inputs, for re-sizing C and B at a planned load.

| Field            | Type     | Required | Description |
| ---------------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `w_mean_seconds` | `number` | Yes      | &gt; 0      |
| `w_p99_seconds`  | `number` | Yes      | &gt; 0      |
| `cv`             | `number` | Yes      | ≥ 0         |

### modelMemory

The router's working set against requests in flight per replica, WS = baseline + m × L, with the request size it was measured at.

| Field                 | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                            |
| --------------------- | --------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseline_bytes`      | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                                                                    |
| `bytes_per_in_flight` | `number`  | Yes      | &gt; 0                                                                                                                 |
| `stages`              | `integer` | Yes      | Usable stages the line was fitted through. ≥ 2                                                                         |
| `request_bytes_mean`  | `number`  | No       | Mean request body size over the usable stages; absent when the engine reported none. &gt; 0                            |
| `queue_size`          | `integer` | No       | The recommended B for the router, held in memory beside C. ≥ 0                                                         |
| `limit_headroom`      | `number`  | No       | The sizing policy's limit headroom h\_lim, applied to the working set before it is compared with the memory limit. ≥ 0 |
